reason: Policy violation: A flight can only be cancelled if booked within the last 24 hours, cancelled by the airline, is in business class, or has travel insurance covering the cancellation reason. The reservation was booked on 2024-05-01 (over 24 hours ago), has economy cabin, no insurance, flights are available (not cancelled), and the reason is change of plan. The agent is proceeding to cancel an ineligible reservation.
